newsitem.title: USA: Nuevo sets '97 capital spending at $140mln.
newsitem.headline: Nuevo sets '97 capital spending at $140mln.

text.p: Nuevo Energy Co Tuesday set its 1997 capital budget at $140 million, up 51 percent from 1996's $93 million.
About $115 million will be allocated to exploitation and the remaining $25 million to exploration.
The exploitation spending is anticipated to consist of $83 million in California, $20 million in East Texas and the Gulf Coast region, and $12 million internationally.
The exploration spending is to be allocated $12 million in East Texas and the Gulf Coast region, $8 million in California, and $5 million internationally.
